title: State School Fund by two-year budget, billions of dollars, not adjusted for inflation
description: Bar chart of Oregon's State School Fund: the 2023-25 legislatively approved and 2025-27 adopted budgets, and the 2027-29 current service level estimate.
notes: The 2023-25 figure is the legislatively approved budget: the adopted budget updated by later legislative sessions and Emergency Board actions [SRC:fiscal/das/2026-03_budget-instructions-2027-29.pdf p.6] [SRC:fiscal/das/2026-03_budget-instructions-2027-29.pdf p.20].
2027-29 is the current service level estimate, not a budget the Legislature passed [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103].

The current service level is the cost of continuing existing programs, updating the last budget for pay, benefits, pension rates, inflation and enrollment [SRC:gov/press/2024_ssf-csl-proposal.html] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.111] [SRC:legislature/olis/2025R1/307212_sb5516-ssf-work-session.pdf p.2].

The figure shown is the Department of Administrative Services' estimate in the Quality Education Commission's 2026 Quality Education Model report, dated August 2026 [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.1] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.13] [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103].
